name: NETANNAD
source: In the near future, A.D.2265. There is a huge tower above the capital of Japan, Chukyo, called Sumeru. Rumor says people live inside in peace, without competition, kind to each other. Pierces through high clouds, shines black as obsidian.
translation: 近未來，西元2265年。日本首都中京上空聳立著一座名為「須彌」的巨大高塔。傳聞人們在塔內和平生活，彼此友善，不存在競爭。高塔刺穿雲層，閃耀著黑曜石般的光芒。
